laws.statement: Claims must conserve their evidence trail across summaries, dashboards, and commits.
Agency expands only where operator approval, platform policy, and data boundaries agree.
Unverified claims decay into lore unless refreshed by source-bound receipts.
Every live-write move needs a rollback or at least a forward-only recovery path.
Compute, money, attention, and battery are finite and must be budgeted as first-class resources.
No secret, token, cookie, or personal credential becomes a research or logging artifact.
Human, AI, and institutional participants are modeled with respect but not false equivalence.
Scientific GMUT-adjacent claims must be marked speculative unless testable predictions exist.
A tool may act only inside the scope granted by its platform and current project trust.
External systems stay held until a concrete, supervised action is approved.
Agent identity is receipt-backed, not asserted as persistent without durable proof.
A phase succeeds only by reporting what happened, including blockers.
